title: NIST AI RMF 1.0

source.name: NIST AI 100-1, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

note: The AI RMF Core's 72 subcategories, with short titles written by this project, mapped onto the control library. NIST's text is in the public domain; read the full subcategory text and the Playbook's suggested actions at the source. There is no certification: an organization self-assesses against it and signs its own attestation. A subcategory no control in the library genuinely covers maps to none, so the organization states its position on it (or maps a control of its own).
